usageNotes: Use this to inspect the full configuration of a named PDM view, including its include/exclude filter rules and layout. The caller must hold Resource.Audit on the view path; views are created and managed separately via the config/views collection endpoints. The 'id' must match the stored view name exactly — there is no fuzzy or prefix matching.

examples.summary: Fetch the configuration of a view named 'production-vms'

tips: View IDs follow the pattern /^(?:[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9._\-]*)$/ — hyphens and dots are allowed but the first character must be alphanumeric or underscore.
The 'include-all' flag in the response means the view shows every resource unless explicitly excluded; when false, only resources matching 'include' rules appear.
Filter rules support an optional 'exact:' prefix to force literal matching rather than prefix/pattern matching on pool, tag, and remote names.
The 'layout' field is an opaque JSON-encoded string used by the PDM UI; it is safe to ignore in API consumers.
